# Scientific Visualization Payload Provenance

The immutable payload under
`vendor/scientific-visualization/` was exported from the author's
author-controlled private skill repository at commit
`235ed3af614a7becaee6ef1d1a18e5c4b13994f4`. The latest commit touching that
directory in the source history was
`52051b3164b0d5c3440cc312c4fa2817b31a1800`.

The author explicitly authorized public MIT inclusion of all 16 Git-tracked
files on 2026-07-18, including the CP/SDS visualization reference. Generated
`__pycache__/` directories and `.pyc` files are not authored source and are
excluded. `ORIGIN.json` records the per-file SHA-256 values and the canonical
aggregate algorithm.

LitHermes adds only sibling adapter, provenance, notice, and license files.
Nothing under the immutable `vendor/scientific-visualization/` directory
is abbreviated, paraphrased, patched, or generated during packaging.
